newsitem.title: UK: GDR REPORT-Indian GDRs await petroleum price rise.
newsitem.headline: GDR REPORT-Indian GDRs await petroleum price rise.

text.p: Indian global depositary receipts ended in positive territory in thin trading on Friday as investors continued their wait for an expected petroleum price rise.
"The market is lethargic - flopping around in a tight band," a broker said, adding that the until the extent of the petroleum price rise was known the market would lack direction.
Indian government ministers have been in discussions this week about a rise in petroleum prices to address a ballooning oil pool deficit.

In the absence of any fundamentals as trading points, volume was largely confined to blue-chip issues such as Hindalco and Tata Engineering and Locomotives, traders said, both of which rose on the day.
The HSBC James Capel Indian GDR index closed 0.61 points up at 78.79, with the premium over the local market at 20.61 percent from 19.95 percent.
Hindalco rose 27 cents to $31.25/$32.25 and Tata Engineering and Locomotives rose 40 cents to $11.50/$12.25.
The Capel Taiwan GDR Index lost 0.82 points, or 0.69 percent, to 118.61, representing a discount to the local market of 2.60 percent.
The Capel Korea GDR Index fell 0.53 points to 64.88 points, a premium of 36.62 percent over the local market.
However, Korean GDRs have gained support in certain sectors in recent days on the back of a more favourable yen/dollar exchange rate, traders said, sparking a rally in major exporters.
